text:
maria: FYI I'm opening a small docs PR to tidy the on-prem deployment checklist — networking ports, KMS/HSM examples, and a short air-gapped section. Found a broken link to the calico note too. Can folks volunteer to own subsections?

aj: I can take networking + the calico link fix. Can you paste the PR draft or branch?

maria: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/482 (WIP) — main changes: consolidated ports table, added note about iptables order, removed stale link to our old calico fork.

aj: quick note — for calico/iptables we should show the minimal iptables-save snippet users need. Suggest:
```
# keep forwarding for pod networking
*filter
:FORWARD ACCEPT [0:0]
-A FORWARD -m comment --comment "allow pods" -j ACCEPT
COMMIT
```
Also add a one-liner for toggling net.ipv4.ip_forward=yes in /etc/sysctl.conf so non-k8s setups don't miss it.

samir: I'll own KMS/HSM examples. We need 2 small snippets: 1) how to point the agent to an internal KMS URL + KEK path, 2) example PKCS11 env for HSM connector. Draft:
```
# KMS example
REDWOOD_KMS_ENDPOINT=https://kms.internal.example.com
REDWOOD_KMS_KEY_PATH=projects/prod/keys/inference-root

# PKCS11 example for HSM (depending on connector)
PKCS11_LIB=/opt/hsm/lib/libpkcs11.so
PKCS11_PIN=1234
```
Add a note that file permissions must be 600 on key config files.

ryan: I'll add the air-gapped notes and apt/yum mirror instructions. Reminder: for air-gapped installs we need to include a step for providing base images and the container registry mirror url. Maybe a small checklist: image bundle, repo mirror, offline package tarball, and timeouts bumped for install scripts.

maria: Perfect. Also there's a broken anchor in "networking#calico-quirks" that 404s from the install guide. aj can you update relative link to point at /guides/calico#quirks?

aj: Yep will change to relative link and add a tiny paragraph about iptables/conntrack limits.

samir: One more: include a short troubleshooting snippet for common HSM errors (CKR_PIN_INCORRECT, CKR_DEVICE_ERROR) and recommend checking CK_LOG and connector logs.

ryan: For air-gapped, can we add an offline test command in the guide so customers can verify offline registry is serving images? e.g. `ctr image pull --plain-http mirror.local:5000/redwood/inference:latest` and a checksum verification. I'll draft that.

maria: Thanks all. Plan: aj updates network + link, samir KMS/HSM, ryan airgap + registry test. I'll coordinate final review and run a quick technical review on staging. Target to merge by 1779002000.

docs-bot: Reminder: docs PR 482 assigned reviewers: @aj, @samir, @ryan — CI: spellcheck + linkcheck queued.

aj: :thumbsup:
samir: :thumbsup:
ryan: will test the offline pull today and report back by EOD.
maria: added a small comment to the PR about adding a size estimate for the image bundle.

ryan: update: offline pull worked but mirror uses self-signed cert. Added note to include CA to OS trust store.
maria: noted — I'll add CA instructions under airgapped section.

(moderate-length thread, final message pinned to PR for visibility)
